title: Exact scalar extension of normalized quotient systems and integral reductions
statement:
Fix the global finite-field datum of [def-pur-conventions], with algebraic closure $k$ of characteristic $p$ and a prime $\ell\ne p$. Let $E\subset F$ be finite extensions of $\mathbf Q_\ell$, with valuation rings $R=\mathcal O_E\subset S=\mathcal O_F$ [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension]. Let $X,Y$ be separated finite-type $k$-schemes and $f:X\to Y$ smooth separated of pure relative dimension $d\ge0$ [def-sbc-smooth-morphisms, def-sf-setting]. For $T=X,Y$, put $A_{n,T}=(R/\ell^n)_T$, $B_{n,T}=(S/\ell^n)_T$ on the small pro-etale site, and use the ordinary derived categories of strict varying-coefficient towers [sk-def-sp-coefficient-towers, det-sp-coefficient-towers-abelian]. Write $\mathcal N_A(T),\mathcal N_B(T)$ for their normalized constructible subcategories with uniform cohomological and Tor bounds [sk-def-sp-normalized-towers], and $C_T=-\otimes^L_{A_{\bullet,T}}B_{\bullet,T}$ for scalar extension of whole systems [lem-coef-semilinear-derived-sections]. Twists mean [def-coefficient-twists-detailed]. Put $R_T=\varprojlim_n A_{n,T}$ and $S_T=\varprojlim_n B_{n,T}$, and $\widehat C_T=-\otimes^L_{R_T}S_T$. There are compatible finite bases $B_{n,T}\cong A_{n,T}^{\oplus[F:E]}$ obtained by reduction of one basis of $S_T$ over $R_T$. On abelian strict coefficient systems scalar extension is exact; on their ordinary derived categories it agrees with $C_T$, whose underlying restricted complex is a fixed finite sum, including all transitions. This functor preserves $\mathcal N_A(T)$ and every common Tor-amplitude interval and cohomological bound. For every $K\in D(R_T)$ there is a canonical natural isomorphism of entire derived $B_\bullet$-systems
$$\operatorname{red}_{S,T}(\widehat C_TK)\simeq C_T(\operatorname{red}_{R,T}K),$$
whose level $n$ is
$$(K\otimes^L_{R_T}S_T)\otimes^L_{S_T}B_{n,T}\simeq(K\otimes^L_{R_T}A_{n,T})\otimes^L_{A_{n,T}}B_{n,T}.$$
Here reduction and its actual quotient transitions are [det-sp-reduction-tower-normalized]; on one flat-term K-flat representative the isomorphism is $(x\otimes a)\otimes b\mapsto x\otimes ab$, with insertion-of-one inverse. These maps respect every quotient transition, all morphisms, identity extensions and successive field extensions. Powers of $\ell$ are interpreted as the cofinal powers $\varpi_E^{h_En}$ and $\varpi_F^{h_Fn}$ when $\ell=u_E\varpi_E^{h_E}=u_F\varpi_F^{h_F}$; no unramifiedness is assumed.

proof.text: Finite type over the field scheme makes X and Y Noetherian. Transfer this structure to T using T=X or T=Y. Apply the single-inclusion construction independently for each finite coefficient embedding and choose its witness within this existence proof. These are normalized functors up to the prescribed canonical tensor comparisons; bases need not compose.

Apply the identity-comparison theorem to the chosen identity datum, and the successive-comparison theorem to the three chosen data for any pair of composable field embeddings. These results hold for arbitrary supplied normalized data, so no compatibility of independently chosen bases is required. They supply exactly Family.identity and Family.successive.

The DVR description of O_E factors nonzero ell as a unit times pi^h. Its extending absolute value is less than one, so ell is not a unit and h>0. Principal ideals ignore the unit factor and (I^h)^n=I^(hn), including n=0. Supply these equalities as Family.cofinal and assemble the record.
